scheduleNote: Sandbox fee schedule for testing checkout. These amounts are not a live price and are not charged to a bank or card.

refund.beforeWork: Cancel before staff start the work and the sandbox payment is reversed in full.
refund.afterStart: Once work has started, the delivered portion is not reversed. A new scope needs a new order.
refund.notDelivered: If the written scope is not delivered, you can request a reversal of that order.
refund.excluded: Travel, venue hire, translation, apostille, and government fees are not refunded by Amanikah because Amanikah does not collect them.

free.name: Free membership
includes: Use essential privacy and safety controls, including block, report, and deletion
excludes: A person choosing introductions for you

services.name: Curated introductions
services.summary: A person proposes up to three introductions that match the expectations you wrote.
services.duration: 30 days from the day staff confirm the start
services.delivery: Up to three written introductions, or a written note if fewer people fit the brief
included: Review of the expectations you already saved
Up to three introductions inside the 30 days
A written reason for each introduction
You still accept or decline each one
excluded: A guarantee of marriage or of a reply
Contact details before mutual acceptance
Introductions after the third, or after day 30
Verification of the other person’s documents
services.verificationLimits: This service does not check education, employment, or identity. A suggestion is not a finding that someone is suitable.
additionalCharges: Another set of three introductions is a new order
A document check is a separate service

services.name: Scoped education and employment verification
services.summary: One stated claim about education or employment is compared with the document you submit.
services.duration: 10 business days after the document arrives
services.delivery: A written result that names the claim, the document, the date, and the limit of the check
included: One education claim or one employment claim
Comparison with one document you supply
A result that says confirmed, not confirmed, or unable to check
excluded: A character reference
A check of honesty, income beyond the single claim, or family reputation
Confirmation of every line on a résumé
Any promise that a person is safe
services.verificationLimits: The result covers only the claim and document in the order. It is not ProofPass as a verdict on the person. A missing or unofficial document ends as unable to check.
additionalCharges: Each extra claim is a new order
Translation, if the document is not in English, Hindi, or Urdu, is charged by the translator, not by this fee

services.name: Optional NRI document consistency review
services.summary: A reviewer compares identity and residence documents you choose, looking only for consistency.
services.duration: 15 business days after the set of documents arrives
services.delivery: A written consistency note listing which documents were compared and any mismatch
included: Comparison of up to four documents you submit
A note of matching or differing name, date of birth, and address fields
The review is optional and is not required to express interest
excluded: Visa advice or immigration approval
Apostille, attestation, or legalisation
A finding that someone may enter or live in a country
Verification of a document that was not submitted
services.verificationLimits: Consistency is not authenticity. Amanikah does not contact a government registry in this service and does not confirm immigration status.
additionalCharges: Government, courier, and attestation fees are paid by you to those offices
More than four documents requires a new order

services.name: Personal relationship manager
services.summary: One coordinator helps you prepare for conversations you have already agreed to.
services.delivery: Scheduled check-ins and a written summary after each conversation you ask the coordinator to join
included: One named coordinator for the 45 days
Help preparing questions and a family brief from details you choose to share
excluded: Speaking for you, or accepting a match on your behalf
Therapy, religious rulings, or legal advice
A promise of marriage
Contact with the other person unless both adults have accepted
services.verificationLimits: The coordinator does not score character, sincerity, or compatibility, and does not replace a document check.
additionalCharges: Time past 45 days is a new order
Curated introductions and document checks are separate services

services.name: Public meeting coordination
services.summary: Help setting one meeting in a public place after both adults have accepted an introduction.
services.duration: One meeting, arranged within 21 days of the order
services.delivery: A written plan with time, public place, and who is attending
included: Coordination of one meeting after mutual acceptance
The meeting stays in a public place
Either person can cancel before the meeting
excluded: A private home, a hotel room, or an unescorted trip
Transport, food, and venue hire
A chaperone unless you arrange one
Any meeting before both adults have accepted
services.verificationLimits: Coordination does not verify identity at the door and does not assess how the meeting felt.
additionalCharges: Each additional meeting is a new order
Travel and venue costs are paid by the people attending, not included here
